frame.converter: Each sky position onto the midplane of the inclined disc M31's image layers are baked on (recipe.json), through the image-layer bake's own intersection.

meaning: Star clusters found by Andromeda Project volunteers in the PHAT Hubble imaging, as catalogued by Johnson et al. (2015): one dot per cluster at its catalogue sky position. PHAT covers only the north-east third of the disc, so this layer is complete there and empty elsewhere.

appearance.note: Presentation only: the Milky Way open-cluster layer's blue-white, size and opacity.
